name: Ben's Journal
content:
Ben's Journal - Entry One

Woolley has gone missing, he ran ahead and now we can't find him. There were some god awful noises that came from the elevator too - I swear if it's that new guy we invited playing a prank I'm going to kill him.|Entry Two

It's been two hours now since I became split up from the group. Brad wondered back to find the elevator, he seemed over the whole thing, whilst Arron ran ahead to catch-up with Woolley. You stop for one second and you're all alone. At least the crazy noises seemed to stop, probably a fox or something,|but I'm running out of battery on my flashlight now and I'm starting to get hungry. I can't even find the damn elevator.

This trip blows.|Final Entry

Woolley is dead. I don't know what the hell happened but he's gone. Ripped apart. It's pitch black and the noises have started again. Coming here was a mistake. New guy, if you read this, get out whilst you still can.
